podcast.body: Co-written with Pharrell Williams, this song was released in 2013 and became the subject of a major plagiarism lawsuit filed by Marvin Gaye's estate. Thicke and Williams stated they produced the song as an homage to the "groove and feel" of Gaye's 1977 song "Got to Give It Up." Despite being in a major key with different chord progressions compared to Gaye's minor key, a jury found the song to have copied the "feel and sound," awarding the Gaye estate over $8 million. "the estate of Marvin Gaye objected to the sound and feel of blurred lines by Robin Thicc, a song co-written by Farrell Williams, which was released in 2013."
